items.figureMatrix: Which one fills the empty box?
items.paperFolding: Which one is it when it opens up?
items.newPuzzle: Here is a new kind of puzzle.

items.both-blue-round: Touch the shape that is both blue and round.
items.both-red-round: Touch the shape that is both red and round.
items.between-star: Touch the shape between the two stars.
items.ord-2-triangle: Touch the second triangle from the left.
items.ord-2-circle: Touch the second circle from the left.
items.biggest-bottom: Touch the biggest shape in the bottom row.
items.smallest-top: Touch the smallest shape in the top row.
items.ord-3-square: Touch the third square from the left.
items.below-red-circle: Touch the shape directly below the red circle.
items.between-square: Touch the shape between the two squares.
items.not-circle-not-red: Touch every shape that is not a circle and not red.
items.toprow-except-triangle: Touch every shape in the top row except the triangles.
items.toprow-except-circle: Touch every shape in the top row except the circles.
items.before-triangle-square: Before you touch the triangle, touch the square.
items.before-star-circle: Before you touch the star, touch the circle.
items.before-circle-triangle: Before you touch the circle, touch the triangle.
items.if-star-blue-else-green: If there is a star, touch the blue shape. If there is no star, touch the green shape.
items.count-squares-touch-circles: Count the squares. Then touch that many circles.
items.biggest-top: Touch the biggest shape in the top row.

correct.prompt: short bright cheerful two-note chime, correct answer, glockenspiel, clean, no reverb tail

wrong.prompt: soft gentle low wooden thunk, gentle negative feedback for a child, not harsh, not buzzer

celebrate.prompt: happy short celebratory sparkle arpeggio rising, magical success fanfare, bells

pop.prompt: single soft UI pop click, bubble tap, very short, clean

whoosh.prompt: quick soft whoosh, card sliding into place, gentle
